title: Spoken Discourse Markers
goal: Organise everyday Spanish conversation with pan-Hispanic discourse markers
grammar: marcadores-conversacionales: pues, bueno, mira/mire, oye/oiga, o sea, vamos, ¿no?, ¿verdad?

items: I can choose pan-Hispanic markers (*pues*, *bueno*, *mira/mire*, *oye/oiga*, *o sea*, *vamos*, *¿verdad?*) by function.
I can match *mira / oye* (*tú*) and *mire / oiga* (*usted*) to the register of a conversation.
I can recognise common regional markers while using pan-Hispanic ones naturally.
